items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: especially Bessie told me, she said, 'That's High Society,' don't do it without that.'

ctx.x: Were you patterning your playing on Louie at this time?
I think I just leaned toward Louie then
after hearing Louie -- I'll tell you what I heard. I heard Louie and Bessie Smith once. Someone played the organ --
